acceptance: A rebuttal is accepted on a new head when the cited hunk is unchanged, with a test.
A watchdog kill reports the stage reached and a rerun skips completed stages.
description:
(1) After a fix commit changes the head, `make pr-open REBUTTALS_FILE=...` refuses with 'no local review of this patch exists to dispute', so a rebuttal written for the previous head is wasted and a full preflight plus review round is repeated for a Medium finding. (2) `make pr-preflight` exited 2 / Terminated (Error 79 from the heavy-work watchdog, or SIGTERM) several times on 2026-11-10 when swap was above 90% with parallel sessions, losing 6 to 25 minutes each time with no resume.

Change. (1) Let pr-open re-use a rebuttal for a finding id whose cited file and lines are unchanged in the new head, or print the finding ids that need a new rebuttal. (2) Make preflight resumable per stage, or report which stage the watchdog killed. Related: pr-preflight-linux-vm-env-failures-20261102.

Guardrails: linked worktree; no explanatory comments; changelog fragment if user-facing; no live cloud without owner approval quoted in context; heavy runs through make heavy-run.
